text:
laura (sales): Heads-up: Helios Bank greenlighted a short pilot. Requirements: low-latency WS streaming to our endpoint, deterministic JSON toolcalls (payment authorizations), CSV-friendly structured output for downstream ERP, SAML SSO via their Okta, customer KMS, and EU-only data. They asked for pricing for a 3-month committed pilot and an enterprise onboarding timeline. Sync tomorrow 9am CET.

 tom (se): Quick Q  do they need a server-sent events or full WebSocket? Helios POC says bi-directional WS so we can push updates and receive acks. Also they want explicit message framing for CSV rows.

 priya (eng-runtime): WebSocket is fine. Recommend our /v1/ws/connect with subprotocol `redwood.v1`. Connection handshake sample:
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/ws/connect', 'redwood.v1', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <TOKEN>' } });
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', model: 'redwood-2', stream: true })));
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('evt', m));
```
We support an explicit ACK frame: { "type":"ack","id":"<msg-id>" }. For load we suggest client-side concurrency <= 20 connections per process and per-connection buffering of ~200ms.

 emily (devex): I'll build a tiny helm of examples: Node WS client, Python asyncio client, and a tiny adapter that converts model JSON output into CSV rows with a schema mapping. Proposed schema: transaction_id, timestamp, account_id, amount, currency, status.

 ravi (security): Important notes: customer KMS for encryption-at-rest is supported on Private and Dedicated; hosted requires envelope encryption with customer-managed keys via our KMS integration (we have docs). For SSO we need metadata.xml from their Okta and a service provider cert. Also they asked about pen-test and SOC2 evidence. Ask them to attach the security questionnaire.

 laura (sales): Sent their questionnaire to me. They also want a predictable latency SLO: 95th <= 150ms for single-step toolcall responses at ~30 QPS sustained. Any capacity rec?

 priya (eng-runtime): For 30 QPS with avg 600 tokens and toolcall roundtrip, plan: 4 reserved A100-equivalent instances with autoscale buffer + KV cache. If they need EU-region pinning, that will be a dedicated ring (changes onboarding). I'll draft a cost estimate with reserved vs burst pricing.

 tom (se): They reported sporadic "partial JSON" events when using streaming -> downstream parser. Suggest enabling message-level checksums and sending finalization frame: { "type":"done","id":"<msg-id>", "checksum":"<sha256>" }. That helps detect truncated CSV/JSON.

 emily (devex): Adding a small client-side pattern: accumulate fragments until `done` frame, validate checksum, then emit CSV line. I'll add code snippet and a tiny state machine.

 infra-bot (deploy-bot): Deployment for pilot profile `pilot/helios` queued: ci/4421 in progress.

 ravi (security): Data residency: if they require EU-only logs and processing, best option is Dedicated in eu-west-1 or Private deploy. Note PCI scope implications for payment data; advise redaction and tokenization on client side.

 laura (sales): For procurement they want a single-page pricing summary: pilot committed (3 months) and convert-to-dedicated option. Can we produce conservative and optimistic numbers?

 priya (eng-runtime): Yes. I'll produce two scenarios: conservative (no KV cache, low batching) and optimized (batching, KV cache, quantized model for non-critical calls). Will include expected tokens/hour and est monthly run-rate.

 tom (se): I'll own the Helios-runbook: WebSocket handshake, ack/done frames, retry semantics (exponential backoff with jitter up to 60s), and client reconnection strategy. Will link sample snips.

 emily (devex): Uploading sample repo (internal): https://git.internal/redwood/presales/helios-ws-poc  contains ws-client, csv-adapter, and tooling for checksum validation.

 laura (sales): Can we get the one-pager + spreadsheet + runbook + security answers by EOD PST? Their legal wants rough SLA and timeline for dedicated spin-up (2-3 weeks typical?).

 priya (eng-runtime): Onboarding note: Dedicated in eu-west usually 2-4 weeks depending on networking and KMS provisioning. Private on-prem is longer. I'll annotate timeline assumptions in the doc.

 ravi (security): I'll draft answers for the questionnaire and flag anything that requires legal sign-off. Also request their contact for Okta metadata.

 laura (sales): Great. I'm scheduling the sync and will share Helios POC contact (carlos@heliosbank.com). Thanks team.

 tom (se): Putting a support ticket for SAML exchange and certs: #SUP-8002.

 priya (eng-runtime): Noted. Will post cost spreadsheet link when ready.

 laura (sales): Thanks everyone 64244d
